MapProperties.MapDescription: The melee ruleset: one hero, buildings that raise an army from their charges, relics bought at the Nexus, and a Nexus to break. Terrain and models are composed from a sub-archive.
MapProperties.Author: Realm
MapProperties.HowToPlayInstructions: Your hero is the only unit you command. Begin Construction draws three buildings from the shared deck and shows them in the command grid of your hero and Nexus: pick one for 100 wood and it produces soldiers automatically from its charges, with every soldier matching your hero's level. Spend gold at your Nexus on relics.
